# QR Sugi

> QR Sugi is a free QR code generator for India. It creates static and dynamic QR codes (website, UPI payment, WhatsApp, Wi-Fi, vCard contact card, SMS, phone, email, location, calendar), shows scan analytics, and includes event registration with unique QR passes, phone-camera gate scanning and Excel attendance reports. Static QR codes are free forever and never expire. The site is available in English, Hindi and Marathi. Prices are in Indian rupees.

## Use the tool
- [QR Sugi QR code generator (web app)](https://qrcodescan.streamlit.app): create, design and download QR codes

## Guides
- [Free QR code generator for India](https://milind1248.github.io/qrforge/free-qr-code-generator.html): Make a QR code free in seconds: website, text, Wi-Fi, contact card, WhatsApp, UPI. Static QR codes never expire. Custom colours and PNG download. No signup.
- [UPI QR code generator](https://milind1248.github.io/qrforge/upi-qr-code-generator.html): Create a UPI payment QR code for your shop, invoice or table. Enter your UPI ID, payee name and optional amount. Works with PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm and BHIM.
- [WhatsApp QR code generator](https://milind1248.github.io/qrforge/whatsapp-qr-code-generator.html): Create a WhatsApp QR code that opens a chat with your number and a pre-filled message. Free, no signup, great for shops, enquiries and orders.
- [Wi-Fi QR code generator](https://milind1248.github.io/qrforge/wifi-qr-code-generator.html): Create a Wi-Fi QR code so guests join your network by scanning. Supports WPA/WPA2, WEP and open networks, including hidden SSIDs. Free, no signup.
- [vCard QR code generator (contact card)](https://milind1248.github.io/qrforge/vcard-qr-code-generator.html): Make a contact card QR code with your name, phone, email, company and address. Scanners can save you to their phone in one tap. Free and static.
- [Dynamic QR code generator with analytics](https://milind1248.github.io/qrforge/dynamic-qr-code-generator.html): Create editable dynamic QR codes: change the destination after printing, pause codes, and track scans by day, device and browser. Free plan includes 2.
- [Event registration with QR code passes](https://milind1248.github.io/qrforge/event-registration-qr-code.html): Create an event, take free or UPI-paid bookings, email each guest a QR pass, scan entries at the gate with a phone, and export attendance to Excel.
- [QR codes for restaurants and cafes](https://milind1248.github.io/qrforge/restaurant-menu-qr-code.html): Create a QR code for your restaurant menu, UPI table payment and review link. Update the menu link without reprinting table cards with a dynamic QR.
- [QR Sugi pricing](https://milind1248.github.io/qrforge/pricing.html): QR Sugi plans start free. Starter ₹249/month, Pro ₹699/month, Business ₹1,799/month, with lower prices when billed yearly. Static QR codes are free forever.
